params.name: q
params.description: Keywords or phrases to search for in article title and body.

params.name: searchIn
params.description: Fields to restrict the q search to. Comma-separated list of title, description, content.

params.name: sources
params.description: Comma-separated string of identifiers for the news sources or blogs (max 20).

params.name: domains
params.description: Comma-separated string of domains to restrict the search to.

params.name: excludeDomains
params.description: Comma-separated string of domains to remove from results.

params.name: from
params.description: A date and optional time for the oldest article allowed (ISO 8601).

params.name: to
params.description: A date and optional time for the newest article allowed (ISO 8601).

params.name: language
params.description: The 2-letter ISO-639-1 code of the language.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The order to sort articles in.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The number of results to return per page.

params.name: page
params.description: Use this to page through the results.

items.docs: Search through millions of articles from over 150,000 large and small news sources and blogs.
